title: MascotLogoGeneratorInput
description: Input schema for the Mascot Logo Generator skill

brand_name.description: Company, product, campaign, event, IP, or brand name to feature in the logo

logo_type.description: Type of logo to generate; omit if it should be inferred from the brief

brief.description: What is being branded, who it serves, its value proposition, personality, usage context, and any mascot-related direction

audience.description: Optional target audience or buyer/user group

preferred_style.description: Optional visual style preference, such as minimal, modern, premium, playful, cute, luxury, bold, mysterious, or organic

mascot_source.description: Optional mascot or symbol source, such as deer, bear paw, mammoth head, alien head, crescent moon, helmet, fruit, or another recognizable entity

mascot_feature_focus.description: Optional signature feature to extract, such as antlers, paw pads, tusks, ears, eye shape, head profile, crescent edge, claw, tail curve, or mask

reference_style.description: Optional written description of a visual reference, including layout, typography, color restraint, spacing, and mood. Use references as guidance only, not for copying a mark.

output_layout.description: Preferred direct-render layout. brand-system-board uses a square numbered guideline grid with main logo, favicon, seal, lockup, applications, mockups, symbol meaning, and footer values.

target_platform.description: Which image model prompts to emphasize; default outputs all variants

render_image.description: When true, generate an actual logo image after creating the final prompt if an image-generation tool is available

revision_notes.description: Iteration feedback when refining a previous mascot-derived concept

examples.brief: A quiet fantasy technology brand that needs a mysterious but premium symbol for app icon, merchandise, and community identity.
精品咖啡与轻食品牌，需要一个高级、克制、适合杯套和门店招牌的动物衍生标志。
